security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and URL alerts are Markdown examples or attribution links. Real risks remain where the workflow runs repo-controlled commands, commits, pushes, and creates GitHub pull requests. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or obfuscated payload was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Treat CLAUDE.md and repo-local scripts as untrusted. Ask the user before running any command that is not listed in the skill.
Show the exact file list, commit message, push branch, PR title, and PR body before executing write commands.
Build commit messages and PR bodies with temporary files or safe argument arrays. Avoid inserting unescaped user text into shell strings.

content.user_title: Create GitHub Pull Requests in Japanese
content.value_statement: Manual PR setup can miss changed files, tests, or repository conventions. This skill guides a Japanese-language workflow for review, commit, push, and GitHub PR creation.
actual_capabilities: Reviews git status, diff, and recent commits before staging.
Checks project instructions, tests, linting, and build steps before committing.
Stages files by explicit path instead of broad add commands.
Creates commits with a structured message and Claude Code attribution.
Pushes the branch and creates a GitHub pull request with gh.
limitations: Requires Git, GitHub CLI, repository access, and push permissions.
May run commands described in repository documentation, so user confirmation is important.
Cannot fix test failures without enough project context.

use_cases.title: Feature Branch PR
use_cases.description: Prepare a reviewed branch, run checks, commit approved files, and open a PR.

use_cases.title: Dotfiles Maintenance
use_cases.description: Validate Brewfile or script changes before creating a pull request.

use_cases.title: Japanese Review Workflow
use_cases.description: Keep PR preparation, error explanations, and confirmation requests in Japanese.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pull request for my current branch. Review the diff first, then ask before staging, committing, pushing, and opening the PR.

prompt_templates.title: Run Checks Before Commit
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this branch for a PR. Read the project instructions, identify required checks, run approved checks, and stop if any check fails.

prompt_templates.title: Use the PR Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PR using the repository template. Fill each section from the current changes and ask me to confirm the title and body.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Release PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release pull request from these changes. Group the summary by feature, fix, and maintenance work, then verify tests before pushing.

output_examples.input: Create a PR for the current changes.
output_examples.output: The skill reviews changed files, asks for staging confirmation, creates a commit, pushes the branch, and returns the PR link.
The skill checks for a template, drafts each required section from the diff, and asks for title and body approval.

output_examples.input: A required check fails before commit.
output_examples.output: The skill stops the workflow, explains the failure in Japanese, and suggests the next repair step.

best_practices: Review the diff before approving staging or commit creation.
Run required tests and linters before pushing the branch.
Confirm the PR title, body, and branch before creation.
anti_patterns: Do not stage every file without reviewing the diff.
Do not skip failing checks to create a PR faster.
Do not use it where push access is not intended.

faq.question: Does this skill create commits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a commit after reviewing changes and staging explicit files.

faq.question: Does it push branches to GitHub?
faq.answer: Yes. It pushes the current branch to origin before creating a pull request.

faq.question: Does it use the GitHub CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses gh to create the pull request after preparing the title and body.

faq.question: Can it use an existing PR template?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks for a repository PR template and uses it when present.

faq.question: What language does it use with users?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to communicate with users in Japanese.

faq.question: What should users review before approval?
faq.answer: Users should review changed files, staged paths, the commit message, push target, and PR body.
